original_description: How to run a review that repeats until no finding stays open (code review, security review, UI design review, UI review, or any reviewer-and-builder cycle) in any orchestration, such as the delivery-pipeline workflow, a review walked by hand in conversation, a release QA pass, or a custom Workflow script. Use it whenever work must be "reviewed until clean", whenever a review round finds problems that need fixing and re-checking, when a review loop stops and asks Keith, when resuming a stopped run with Keith's rulings (keithRulings), when deciding what happens to findings at the round cap, or when writing waivers and carried findings to a project's PIPELINE.md. Use it even when the request only says "review this and fix what you find", since that's a review loop.
